builds.summary: Seek the highest restored health from Chronoshift revive health within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.

builds.hypothesis: R3 revival restores1100+2AP; huge AP coefficient rewards Deathcap/raw AP/Staff. Test heal-power/Revitalize eligibility instead of assuming revive ordinary healing. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee increase AP ratio. Staff suppliesAP plus pretriggered40AP Rapids; Redemption/Mikael supply22% combined heal/shield power. Their active heals are excluded. No penetration credit to healing/shielding. 30min Gathering Storm AP is fixed; Revitalize tested on allybelow40%HP; Aery reported separately.

kitEvidence.formula: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for [5] seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for [3] seconds, then reviving them and restoring [600 / 850 / 1100 + (2) × AP] Health.

builds.name: Time Bomb: legal two-bomb sequence
builds.summary: Investigate high two Time Bomb explosions from one Q-W-Q sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high two Time Bomb explosions from one Q-W-Q sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Q deals 75/115/165/230/300 + 0.9 AP magic. A second bomb on the same bombed unit detonates the first immediately and stuns; the second still has its own three-second timer. Two legal rank-5 explosions nominally total 600 + 1.8 AP, not three damage events from placement and detonation.

ceiling.targetName: two Time Bomb explosions from one Q-W-Q sequence
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed, W learned and actually able to restore Q availability. Two Q casts attach to the same surviving 10000-max-HP champion using one legal Rewind, second attachment within 0.75 seconds of the first. Observe four seconds so the remaining bomb can detonate; record actual mana and timestamps. No extra Q reset or ally bomb carrier assumed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After [3] seconds it detonates, dealing [75 / 115 / 165 / 230 / 300 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.
